description: This file defines the Text class in the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, providing methods for string length, exact matching, text splitting, and other text manipulation functionalities used within spreadsheets.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: A class providing static methods for string manipulation and text processing within spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string or array of strings, respecting UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: exact
methods.description: Compares two text strings for exact case-sensitive match.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Returns the input value if it is a string; returns empty string for other types; processes arrays accordingly.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a text into an array based on specified row and column delimiters, with options for case sensitivity and empty cell handling.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Converts a 2D array into a string representation, optionally formatted.
